issues.detail: The Hebrew 'וְתִקְוָתִי מִי יְשׁוּרֶנָּה' means 'and my hope—who can see it?' (or 'who can behold it?'), not 'who can defend my hope?' The verb 'יְשׁוּרֶנָּה' (from שׁוּר, 'to see/behold') is rendered as '辯護' (defend), which changes the meaning from perception/visibility to advocacy.
